note: Landing hero keyboard, per locale (en and ko use default). Ids only: what each cap shows is resolved at build time (lib/landing-a/caps.ts). A verified reference with a claimed colour becomes a logo cap when web/src/data/brand-svg.json holds a genuine logo for it whose solid fills reach 3:1 on the claimed colour or its pale tint; otherwise it is a glyph cap (native first glyph on the claimed colour). Adding a JP or TW record to brand-svg.json therefore turns that glyph cap into a logo cap with no code change; re-render the posters afterwards (scripts/hero-posters.mjs). Rows are keyboard rows; a wordmark takes a wide cap.
